summary: Farm a Befouled Water on Ra'Kaznar Inner Court fomors, trade it to the Odyssean Passage in Leafallia, get a keyitem that's valid for a BCNM fight in Ra'Kaznar Turris. Choose the Vagary boss you want to face, defeat it for the unlock. I've soloed 3 of them with basic 119 gear (mix of Artifact and Relic armor) just by choosing the right Trust comp.
